_: The RULED shape of the icon suite. check:logo reads this and compares it
against what the files themselves contain, so two sources argue and neither
restates the other. This is an EXPECTATION, deliberately not generator
output: if build-icons.mjs also wrote this file, a regeneration with the
wrong tile would update both sides and the colour probe could never fire.
It is NOT content/generated/assets.json. That manifest carries paths only,
on the documented ground (build-assets.mjs) that bytes and dimensions
derived from the file would be a second copy to go stale. This file carries
what nothing derives: the values a human ruled.
tile is --surface-chrome light, which is brand. The corner probe samples
pixel (0,0) of every raster; see the derivation in check-logo.mjs for why
that point is outside both the mark box and the maskable safe circle.
